summary: Lisata Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting termination of its March 6, 2026 merger agreement with Kuva Labs (Parent) and Kuva Acquisition Corp. Under the agreement, Parent would acquire Lisata shares through a tender offer at $4.00 per share in cash plus one CVR (up to $3.00 per CVR). The termination occurred after Parent failed to accept tendered shares following the July 20, 2026 offer expiration, citing inability to obtain financing. Parent must pay a $2.0M termination fee. Lisata reserves rights to seek additional damages. Watch for potential litigation or a new bidder emerging.
